rows.notes: Board created by Decree 10 of 1969 (Architects Act Cap A19 LFN 2004); distinct from the NIA (association founded 1960, ~12,000 members across all grades, UIA section; the 2022 ARCON-NIA conflict resolved). 4,926 registrants announced by the ARCON president in July 2021; mass inductions since (526 in 2025), so the actual headcount is higher. “Register of Architects and Architectural Firms” page with no public PDF; online verification portal operational. Categories: architects, technologists, firms.

State board under the Architects Act 1969 (NLCD 357). Complete nominal list online: 744 architects in good standing as at 30 April 2026, numbered 1-744 (web page); the home page displays the cumulative totals 1,429+ licensed professionals, 258+ firms, 200+ probationers; 2023 report: 1,270 registrants, of whom 650 in good standing — the cumulative total and the in-good-standing figure must be carefully distinguished. GIA = UIA section. Confirmed by direct count on 5 August 2026: 744 exactly (ranks 1-744 continuous, double-checked); + 111 practices and 164 PPE trainees in the corpus annexes.

rows.organisme: Board of Registration of Architects and Quantity Surveyors
rows.notes: Board under Cap 525; register covering architects AND quantity surveyors — count only the architects. Direct count of Gazette Notice no. 2595 of 07.02.2025 (official PDF, in good standing as at 31 January 2025), carried out on 5 August 2026: 1,226 architects — S/No continuous 1-1226, two misprints in the gazette (“Arh.”, one missing title) checked by hand. This corrects the count of 699 taken from the site index (a cross-check planned from the initial harvest onwards). Same gazette: 833 quantity surveyors (no. 2596), 263 architectural practices (no. 2597), 166 quantity surveying practices (no. 2598). AAK (1967, 8 chapters, directory members.aak.or.ke/directory) = UIA section.

Statutory board (Architects Registration Act 1996). PDF “Architects List for 2026” (5 June 2026) counted: 269 architects (numbers 002 to 404, register with gaps), with Practicing Certificate, qualifications and contact details. Members’ portal myarb.info. The Uganda Society of Architects (USA) is the UIA section. CORRECTION 5 August 2026 (direct count of the PDF “Architects List for 2026”): 269 practitioners holding the 2026 certificate — lifetime Reg/No 002-404 with 134 gaps (registrants without a certificate), second count by PC/No 26xxx (269 = 269); the earlier 273 came from a previous edition of the same living list.

rows.organisme: Architects and Quantity Surveyors Registration Board
rows.notes: Board under Act no. 4/2010 (Cap 269), seat in Dodoma. Complete public list on the ORS portal, counted by crawling: 1,944 professionals, of whom 693 architects (960 QS, 94 technologists, 35 interior architects…) — count only the 693. AAT = UIA section. Confirmed by direct count on 5 August 2026 (crawl of the 6 ORS pages): 693 exactly (671 Local + 22 Foreign) out of the Board’s 1,944 professionals — of which 961 quantity surveyors, in the corpus annexes.

rows.organisme: South African Council for the Architectural Profession
rows.notes: Statutory council (Architectural Profession Act 44 of 2000). Category PITFALL: 2023/24 report = 11,564 registrants across ALL categories: 4,418 Professional Architects, 1,931 Senior Technologists, 1,116 Technologists, 1,371 Draughtspersons, 2,437 candidates… — count only the 4,418 PrArch. Searchable register (search by name), no downloadable list. SAIA = UIA section.

Hybrid case: the institute IS the statutory authority — Zambia Institute of Architects Act (Cap 442, 1995). UIA section. Register not published: access through the members’ portal; the site returns 403 to robots; no official headcount online.

Statutory council (Architects Act Ch. 27:01, 1976). Public list on the joint IAZ/ACZ site, counted: 64 names — probably partial (active practitioners), to be treated with caution. No UIA section listed.

Board under Cap 61:08; annual register published as web tables: 2025 = 274 architects + 67 technologists + 9 draughtspersons — count only the 274. Bounded scopes of practice: technologist ≤250 m², draughtsperson ≤150 m². AAB = UIA section. CORRECTION 5 August 2026 (direct count of the 2025 register): 275 architects — the printed ranks stop at 274 but one line (01240350) is entered without a rank; + 68 technologists and 9 draughtspersons in the corpus annexes.

rows.organisme: Namibia Council for Architects and Quantity Surveyors
rows.notes: Council under Act 13 of 1979 (inherited from South African law). Public search via search.mymembership.co.za (the same platform as SACAP). ±132 registered architects + 108 in training across 81 practices (NIA figures) — no official NCAQS statistic. No UIA section listed.

rows.organisme: Board of Architects and Quantity Surveyors
rows.notes: Board established by the 1991 Act (Cap 53:02), the registration and disciplinary authority (architects + QS). No official site and no online register; the scope of the registration requirement has not been verified. No UIA section listed.

rows.organisme: Ministry of Urban Development / Ethiopian Construction Authority (registration of professionals)
rows.notes: Particular regime: neither a professional order nor a board — registration/certificate of competence with the ministry (directive no. 718/2021). Ministerial register not public, no headcount found. The AEA (August 1991, Addis Ababa) is the UIA section; ≈2,000 members cited by secondary sources, not confirmed on aea.et.
No online trace of an Eritrean board, professional order or association of architects; only private practices. No UIA section.
No legal regime specific to architects. SIA founded 2023 (post-conflict reconstruction). Engineers register with the Ministry of Public Works (mpwr.gov.so). No UIA section.

Architects register alongside engineers with the Sudanese Engineering Council (titles of the “Specialist Architect” type). The Sudanese Institute of Architects is the UIA section. War since 2023: institutions in disarray, no public register and no public headcount.

No architects’ board and no architects’ institute. The SSES covers engineers, architects and technologists; an Engineering Council regulates engineering. First school of architecture (Univ. of Juba) created in 2020. No UIA section.

Institute and regulator are one and the same: the SLIA regulates the profession under the Architects Act 1986; admission by examination (4 inducted in July 2024). UIA section; joined the CAA in 2023. No register and no headcount published.

rows.organisme: Architects’ Registration Board (created by the Architects’ Act of 2023)
rows.notes: Emerging regime: the 2023 Act creates a board, installed by the LIA (press 2023-2024). No public register and no headcount as yet. No UIA section.
No Gambian architects’ act, board or institute found online. No UIA section.

Order created by Lei n° 13/2017 (public law, compulsory registration; architects, urban planners, planning). Social media presence (@oarqmoc) but NO official site and no list of registrants; no headcount published. Lusophone sphere (CIALP); no UIA section listed.

UIA section. “Lista Oficial dos Arquitectos Inscritos” no. 9 (year 2024, online February 2025): 37-page nominal PDF, counted = 2,056 registrants (OA-0001 onwards; list no. 8 of August 2024: 1,876) — cumulative list. Admission by examination (the 12th scheduled for October 2026). Seat at Vila Alice, Luanda. Direct count of the Lista oficial 2024 (PDF of 13 February 2025), carried out on 5 August 2026: exactly 2,056, continuous index 1..2056; earlier state of August 2024: 1,876 registrants (+180 in six months).

rows.organisme: Ordem dos Arquitectos de Cabo Verde
rows.notes: Statutes approved by Decreto-Lei n° 60/99 (framework Lei n° 126/IV/95); covers architects and urban planners. Site arquitectos.org.cv (oac.cv parked). “Arquitetos” section with neither list nor headcount accessible. UIA section.

rows.organisme: Ordem dos Engenheiros e Arquitectos de São Tomé e Príncipe
rows.notes: MIXED engineers-and-architects order; registration opened in 2024 (CIALP source). No site of its own, no register and no headcount. No UIA section.

Council created by the PAC Act 2011; the title “Architect” is reserved for registrants. “List of Professional Architects Registered for the Year 2026” published in full as a web table: 331 architects, plus a list of mentors. MAA = UIA section. Seat at Quatre Bornes. CORRECTION 5 August 2026 (direct count of the 2026 table): 274 architects — the 331 was the HIGHEST registration number, not the headcount (57 numbers struck off, listed in the corpus); the 150 “Employment Mentors” are a status, all of them already on the register.

Neither professional order nor board: a licence from the Seychelles Licensing Authority (recognised degree or proof of competence). The “Construction Professional Registration Bill 2022” provided for a Council with a register — adoption not verified. No public headcount. No UIA section.

No registration act found: the AAL is an association (Societies Act 1966) with an online directory; 8 “Active Members / Verified Professionals” displayed — very low coverage, not to be taken for the whole body of practitioners. No UIA section.

rows.organisme: Architects, Engineers, Surveyors and Allied Professionals Registration Council
rows.notes: MIXED council created by Act no. 15 of 2013; the act provides for a register and for site audits. No operational site (aesap.org.sz does not resolve); headcount and register not public. No UIA section.

rows.organisme: Egyptian Engineers Syndicate (نقابة المهندسين), architecture division
rows.notes: Architects are registered WITH the engineers in the syndicate (laws 66/1947 then 66/1974; membership required in order to practise), within the architecture division. The division’s headcount has never been published (searches in AR/EN); all divisions: 470,000 (2012), >500,000 cited at the 2024 elections, ~30,000 new members a year. The SEA is the UIA section; syndicate site eea.org.eg.
